title: Common contract definitions
description: Shared $defs for the compatibility-contract schemas. Ids are opaque; nothing is fetched at validation time.

timestamp.description: Contract A6: full UTC date+time. A separate runner lint rejects the midnight value, which a pattern cannot express cleanly.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the task root (artifacts) or the repository root (task_path).

short_id.description: Opaque identifier used for run, dispatch, session and umbrella ids.

uuid7.description: UUID version 7, optionally carrying an `evt_` prefix in contract C7 event files.

node_id.description: Workflow node id (grammar B1) and phase-summary key for chain runs.

task_dir_name.description: Task directory name: date prefix plus slug. The prefix is exempt from A6.

workflow_type.description: The five workflow types a task directory can belong to.

phase_status.description: Status of a phase row (A1 phase bookkeeping, A2 phases[]).

task_status.description: Status of the task as a whole (A1 task.status, A2 task.status).

version1.description: Format version of the versioned contracts (B1, C1-C5, C7, E2). An unknown version degrades on read, it never throws.

artifact_ref.description: One produced artifact. Paths are relative to the task root.

decision_item.description: A recorded decision. Three frozen shapes: a bare string, the writer form carrying `decision` with an optional `rationale`, and the question/answer form the development workflow writes into its clarifications key.

phase_summary_entry.description: The shared base shape of a phase summary. Open by design: every workflow adds its own keys (key_findings, steps_completed, integration_points, ...). Absence of a key is equivalent to the empty value.

phase_summary_value.description: The value of one phase_summaries key. Either an entry or a bare list of decision items — the array form is what the development workflow writes for its clarifications key and is accepted unchanged.
